question: To whom and under what test condition must a particular teaching be given rather than withheld?
premises: A teaching is only to be given to one previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for a full year.
The obligation to give applies only under that tested condition.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one who is previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
plain_english: It is to be given only to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
